description: This file contains seed scripts for generating test data in a Prisma-based database, including creating organizations, teams, users, bookings, routing forms, and payment scenarios for a software project.

methods.name: getRandomBookingStatus
methods.description: Returns a random booking status excluding AWAITING_HOST.

methods.name: getRandomRatingFeedback
methods.description: Returns a random feedback string from a predefined list.

methods.name: shuffle
methods.description: Shuffles and populates booking data with random times, statuses, and metadata.

methods.name: createAttendees
methods.description: Creates attendee records for a list of bookings.

methods.name: _createPayments
methods.description: Creates payment records for paid bookings.

methods.name: createPaymentsForScenarios
methods.description: Creates payment records for bookings with diverse payment scenarios.

methods.name: createDiversePaymentBookings
methods.description: Creates various event types and bookings with different payment and refund scenarios for testing.

methods.name: seedBookingAssignments
methods.description: Assigns random routing reasons to a subset of bookings.

methods.name: seedRoutingTraces
methods.description: Creates routing trace records based on booking assignment reasons and form responses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to set up organization, teams, users, bookings, routing forms, and payment scenarios.

methods.name: runMain
methods.description: Executes main seed process with error handling and cleanup.

methods.name: createPerformanceData
methods.description: Creates large amounts of test data for performance testing, including users, events, and bookings.

methods.name: runPerformanceData
methods.description: Runs performance data creation with error handling and cleanup.

methods.name: runEverything
methods.description: Runs all seed scripts including main setup and performance data creation.
